note: Human-reviewed FULL LEGAL NAMES for CISUC `people` rows whose published display name is not a truncation of the person's real name. CISUC publishes "António Dourado" for a man whose name is António Dourado Pereira Correia, and Estudo Geral writes him "Correia, António Dourado Pereira" — the two forms share the given names and NOT the surname, so analysis/name_match.py's `_fits()` rejects them in both directions and the person is simply unmatched. No name rule can recover that: nothing in "António Dourado" says the surname "Correia" is missing rather than wrong, and the rule change that would accept it is measured-rejected relaxation B (docs/thesis-attribution.md), which also produced "Cruz, Luís Alberto da Silva" -> "Luís Silva". So, exactly like data/person_aliases.json, every entry here is a decision a person made against a citable source, with the evidence written down — and the matcher gets one extra, GATED fit direction (`name_match._fits_full`) that runs only against these reviewed names. A match found that way is capped at the `confident` tier, never `exact`: what it agrees with is a reviewed declaration, not the identity CISUC itself publishes. Adding a wrong entry silently lands a wrong person at that tier, which is the one failure this app exists to avoid — `evidence` is mandatory and is not decoration, and analysis/person_full_names.py additionally refuses an entry whose full name does not account for every token CISUC already publishes. This file is NOT a thesis-name lookup — that is option C, rejected by the Product Owner. It states a person-level fact, upstream of any thesis, checkable by anyone against the source named below. See docs/thesis-attribution.md.

entries.evidence: CISUC's own bio declares it verbatim: "Full name: António Dourado Pereira Correia (short: António Dourado)", in the Short Bio block of https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/antonio-dourado — server-rendered in the raw HTML, re-fetched and read directly on 2026-10-15. The directory publishes him as "António Dourado", dropping the surname Estudo Geral files him under. Corroborated per thesis, not merely by name: all six theses naming him (10316/27608, /1764, /10153, /1758, /1760, /23583; 2001-2015) are epileptic-seizure prediction, adaptive control and neuro-fuzzy systems — his own lab's specialty. He is the only person in the 905-row roster whose full name can carry the surname Correia alongside the given names Estudo Geral records.

Her own doctoral thesis, inside this corpus, is the source: Estudo Geral 10316/1748 is authored by "Oliveira, Marília Pascoal Curado de", a 2005 UC thesis on QoS routing — and her CISUC bio (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/marilia-curado) records a PhD in Informatics Engineering from the University of Coimbra in 2005. Same year, same institution, same subject, so the thesis author and the directory entry are one person. CISUC publishes her as "Marilia Curado", dropping "de Oliveira". Corroborated by the three theses she supervises under the long form (10316/22105 IoT resilience, /95281 Fog orchestration, /95282 wireless multi-hop routing) — exactly her Networks, Communications and Security specialty. Her CISUC bio does NOT state the legal name; it was checked on 2026-10-15 and carries no "Full name:" declaration.

Wikipedia's article on him gives the full name verbatim as "Fernando Pedro Lopes Boavida Fernandes" — a token-for-token match with the Estudo Geral form "Fernandes, Fernando Pedro Lopes Boavida". CISUC publishes him as "Fernando Boavida" (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/fernando-boavida), dropping the surname "Fernandes". Both theses he supervises under the long form (10316/1757, IPv6/ATM, 2001; 10316/24526, P2P overlays, 2013) are his networks specialty, and the 2001 one's author is filed as "Silva, Jorge Miguel Sá" — the person data/person_aliases.json already reviewed as jorge-silva — which independently corroborates that this corpus records UC networking people under their full civil names. His CISUC bio does NOT state the legal name; it was checked on 2026-10-15 and carries no "Full name:" declaration.

One of the two theses this entry recovers states it on its own title page. 10316/41880 (Ricardo Manuel da Conceição Rodrigues, "RAPPORT: A Fact-Based Question Answering System for Portuguese", DEI/FCTUC, June 2017) declares itself "supervised by Professor Paulo Jorge de Sousa Gomes and Professor Fernando Jorge Penousal Martins Machado" — the full name verbatim, naming the same human Estudo Geral files on that thesis as the bare "Machado, Fernando" (https://comum.rcaap.pt/entities/publication/f6e56775-1554-45c4-9aba-5bf743d29e53; https://estudogeral.sib.uc.pt/handle/10316/41880). CiênciaVitae records the same full name: he publishes, and is published, under his third given name "Penousal", which is what CISUC prints (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/penousal-machado). Corroborated a third time inside this corpus — nine theses already resolve to this slug from the Estudo Geral form "Machado, Fernando Jorge Penousal Martins" (10316/9599 as author; /117599, /119468, /81287, /94987, /95269, /95271, /96431, /96432 as supervisor) through ordinary display-name coverage, so that long form and the slug are an already-confirmed pair. The other recovered thesis (10316/31166, Pedro Cruz, "Semantic figurative metaphors in information visualization", 2016) is his own Computational Design and Visualization group's specialty. His CISUC bio does NOT state the legal name; it was checked on 2026-10-15 and carries no "Full name:" declaration.

His own national CV record states it verbatim: CiênciaVitae 8516-32CE-6517 gives "Nome completo: FERNANDO AMÍLCAR BANDEIRA CARDOSO" and lists "Amilcar Cardoso" and "F. Amilcar Cardoso" among his citation names — so the registry itself ties this legal name to the exact form CISUC publishes (https://www.cienciavitae.pt/portal/8516-32CE-6517, read 2026-10-16). UC's own faculty directory prints the same short form, "F. Amílcar Cardoso" (https://apps.uc.pt/mypage/faculty/uc24291), as does his CISUC page (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/f-cardoso). This is the opposite defect to António Dourado's: CISUC does not drop a surname here, it adds a given-name initial the Estudo Geral form never carries, so `_fits()` rejects "F." as abbreviating no thesis given name — measured-rejected relaxation A's exact territory (docs/thesis-attribution.md), which is why this is a reviewed fact and not a rule change. Both recovered theses are his own Cognitive and Media Systems specialty, computational creativity: 10316/1747 ("Um modelo computacional de criatividade", 2005) and 10316/9599 ("Inteligência artificial e arte", 2007, authored by the Penousal Machado this file already records).

Read off the award record of his own doctorate: White Rose eTheses Online files the 1995 University of Sheffield PhD "Multiobjective genetic algorithms with application to control engineering problems" under the author "Fonseca, Carlos Manuel Mira da" (https://etheses.whiterose.ac.uk/id/eprint/1887/, read 2026-10-16) — and his CISUC page records exactly that doctorate, Sheffield, 1996 award (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/carlos-fonseca). His CiênciaVitae entry (8216-4040-E73E) declares only the published short form "Carlos M Fonseca" and so cannot settle the "M.", which is the whole gap: CISUC prints an initial the thesis form "Fonseca, Carlos" never carries, so `_fits()` rejects it the same way it rejects f-cardoso. Recovers one thesis, 10316/32725 (Ivo Gonçalves, generalization and overfitting in genetic programming, 2017) — Adaptive Computation, his own group, co-supervised with Sara Silva. **This entry must not resolve "Fonseca, José Carlos"**: `people` separately holds jose-fonseca-1, "José Carlos Coelho Martins da Fonseca" of IPG, and "josé" appears nowhere in this full name, so `_fits_full` rejects that name here — the false positive measured-rejected relaxation A produced is structurally unreachable, and tests/test_name_match.py asserts it.

UC's own faculty directory publishes her under this name: https://apps.uc.pt/mypage/faculty/uc22660 is titled "Maria José Patrício Marcelino", Assistant Professor at DEI/FCTUC, researching Computer Science Education in CISUC's Cognitive and Media Systems group (read 2026-10-16). Her CISUC row carries the same four names, "Maria José Patricio Marcelino" (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/maria-marcelino) — note the card that commissioned this work believed CISUC dropped "Patrício"; it does not, and that is why no alias is involved. The gap is the other way round: Estudo Geral files her on 10316/79528 as the shorter "Marcelino, Maria José", and `_fits()` cannot excuse the two directory names the thesis form never mentions. That thesis (Adilson Vahldick, a serious game for introductory programming, 2018) is exactly her own specialty, and she co-supervised it with the antonio-mendes this file also records.

Two independent institutional records agree that his complete name is these three names and no more: his own CiênciaVitae entry declares "Nome completo: Antonio Jose Mendes" (861D-3518-E20A, https://www.cienciavitae.pt/861D-3518-E20A, read 2026-10-16), and UC's faculty directory publishes him as "António José Mendes", Full Professor at DEI/FCTUC and its Director 2013-2017 (https://apps.uc.pt/mypage/faculty/uc22803). CISUC prints the same three names, "Antonio Jose Mendes" (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/antonio-mendes). So the defect is purely that Estudo Geral files him shorter: 10316/79528 names him "Mendes, António", and `_fits()` rejects the directory row because the thesis form cannot account for "José". Corroborated per thesis rather than by name alone — 10316/79528 is Computer Science Education, his own CISUC group's specialty, co-supervised with Maria José Marcelino, whose entry above has the identical shape.

Her own doctoral thesis, inside this corpus, is the source: Estudo Geral 10316/95282 ("Mechanisms for Latency Reduction in Fog Environments", 2021) is authored by "Castro, Karima Daniela Velasquez", supervised by Marília Pascoal Curado de Oliveira and Edmundo Monteiro — and CISUC publishes a "Karima Velasquez" in exactly that Networks, Communications and Security circle (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/karima-velasquez, read 2026-10-16). CISUC's short form drops the trailing surname Estudo Geral files her under, so the two forms share "Karima" and "Velasquez" and NOT the surname "Castro" — the António Dourado shape, which `_fits()` rejects in both directions. The identification rests on the supervisor pair and the fog/cloud subject matching her CISUC page, not on the name strings; she is the only person in the roster whose published form can sit inside this thesis name.

His own doctoral thesis, inside this corpus, is the source: Estudo Geral 10316/23583 ("Development of classification methods for real-time seizure prediction", 2013) is authored by "Leitão, Bruno Miguel Direito Pereira" and supervised by António Dourado Pereira Correia and Miguel Castelo Branco — and CISUC publishes a "Bruno Direito" (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/bruno-direito, read 2026-10-16) whose work is seizure prediction and biomedical signal analysis, now at CIBIT/LASI at UC. He publishes under the two middle names and not the trailing surname, so the CISUC form and the thesis form share nothing on the surname "Leitão" and `_fits()` rejects them. Identified on the thesis's supervisor pair and subject — Dourado's own epileptic-seizure-prediction line, the same cluster this file's antonio-dourado entry documents — rather than on the name text.

A compound surname, not a dropped one: his own CiênciaVitae declares "Nome completo: Mário Zenha-Rela" with the single citation name "Zenha-Rela, Mário" (0018-DB31-C1BF, ORCID 0000-0003-1985-9344, https://www.cienciavitae.pt/portal/en/0018-DB31-C1BF, read 2026-10-16), and UC's faculty directory publishes him the same way (https://apps.uc.pt/mypage/faculty/uc24500), as does CISUC (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/mario-zenha-rela). Estudo Geral files him on both theses as the bare "Rela, Mário", dropping the "Zenha-" half of the surname, and `_fits()` rejects the directory row because the thesis form cannot account for "Zenha". Recovers the two theses he co-supervised, both dependability work with a CISUC co-supervisor from his own circle: 10316/24888 (FPGA weblab, 2014, with Gustavo Alves) and 10316/29594 (reliability prediction from software architectures, 2016, with Raul Barbosa).

Already corroborated twice inside this repo before this entry existed. data/person_aliases.json rules jorge-silva ("Jorge Sá Silva", sasilva@deec.uc.pt) and j-silva ("Jorge Miguel Sa Silva", sasilva@dei.uc.pt) one human on a shared mailbox local part — so CISUC itself publishes this exact four-name form under the aliased slug — and this file's fernando-boavida entry independently records that 10316/1757's author is filed by Estudo Geral as "Silva, Jorge Miguel Sá", a name that already resolves to this slug through ordinary display-name coverage. His CISUC page confirms the Associate Professor at DEEC/UC and senior CISUC researcher in the Laboratory of Communications and Telematics (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/jorge-silva, read 2026-10-16). What this entry adds is the one thesis that files him shortest: 10316/28862 ("Performance Measurement in Wireless Sensor Networks", 2016) names him "Silva, Jorge", which `_fits()` cannot account for against either directory form, and whose subject and co-supervisor (Edmundo Monteiro) are his own group's. The card that commissioned this asked for the CISUC duplicate to be verified and deduped — it already was, in person_aliases.json, so no alias change is needed here.

His own doctoral thesis, inside this corpus, is the source: Estudo Geral 10316/118766 ("A Privacy Aware Architecture for Electronic Health Records", 2025) is authored by "Silva, Rodrigo Ronner Tertulino da" and supervised by Naghmeh Ramezani Ivaki of CISUC's Software and Systems Engineering group — and CISUC publishes him under the slug r-silva with the display name "Rodrigo Tertulino" (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/r-silva, read 2026-10-16), the name he publishes under. The published form keeps a middle name and drops the surname Estudo Geral files him under, so the two share nothing on "Silva" and `_fits()` rejects them in both directions — and this is the near-miss name_match.py's own docstring names as deliberately left unmatched by the no-transliteration/no-similarity rules. It is resolved here as a reviewed fact instead: the thesis, its 2025 date and its CISUC SSE supervisor are the identification, not a string distance.

entries.full_name: Fernando José Barros Rodrigues da Silva
entries.evidence: His own doctoral thesis, inside this corpus, is the source: Estudo Geral 10316/1901 ("Modelação e simulação de sistemas de eventos discretos com estrutura dinâmica", 1997, supervised by Maria Teresa Ferreira Soares Mendes of DEI) is authored by "Silva, Fernando José Barros Rodrigues da" — and CISUC publishes a "Fernando Barros" (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/fernando-barros, read 2026-10-16), Assistant Professor at DEI/UC, whose research line is the Theory of Modelling and Simulation and who is the author of Dynamic Structure DEVS. That is precisely what this 1997 thesis introduces, which is the identification: the published form keeps a middle name and drops the trailing surname, so the CISUC form and the thesis form share nothing on "Silva" and `_fits()` rejects them. Note the surname is common to three entries in this file; each is separated by its given names, and the measured rebuild confirms no thesis name reaches more than one of them.

His own national CV declares it: CiênciaVitae 1D17-8FBA-A9D9 gives "Nome completo: Francisco Baptista Pereira", Professor at the Coimbra Institute of Engineering (ISEC, Polytechnic of Coimbra) and researcher in CISUC's Bio-inspired Artificial Intelligence group, PhD Computer Engineering UC 2002 (https://www.cienciavitae.pt/1D17-8FBA-A9D9, read 2026-10-16); CISUC prints the same three names (https://www.cisuc.uc.pt/en/people/francisco-pereira-1). This one entry resolves BOTH of the corpus's unmatched Francisco Pereira supervisor rows, which the research confirmed are one human: 10316/87416 ("Self Adaptation in Ant Colony Optimisation", 2019) files him "Pereira, Francisco" and 10316/29450 ("Enhancing Grammar-Based Approaches for the Automatic Design of Algorithms", 2016) files him "Pereira, Francisco B." — both co-supervised with Ernesto Costa, both bio-inspired optimisation, both his own group's specialty. The "B." is why `_fits_full` rule 2 now accounts for a single-letter THESIS token that prefixes a full-name token ("B." for "Baptista"); see docs/thesis-attribution.md's amendment under this section. Francisco Câmara Pereira (francisco-pereira) is a different human and is untouched: the thesis name he authors, "Pereira, Francisco Colunas Pereira da Câmara", carries "colunas" and "câmara", neither of which appears in this full name, so `_fits_full` rejects him here while his own display name still fits him first.
